name: 金丹雷劫
desc: 九天雷霆降下，金丹雷劫已至！
descEn: Nine Heavens thunder descends -- the Golden Core tribulation is here!

name: 元婴心魔
desc: 心魔化形而出，元婴劫数将至！
descEn: The heart demon manifests -- the Nascent Soul tribulation approaches!

name: 化神天火
desc: 三昧真火焚天炼地，化神之劫降临！
descEn: Samadhi True Fire scorches heaven and earth -- the Spirit Severing tribulation descends!
